stable_optimization_schema.name: OptimizationSpec
stable_optimization_schema.invariant: The conversational boundary may compile to this schema but never introduces a parallel optimization schema.

safety_invariants: Hard constraints are preserved exactly and are never inferred from confidence or provider output.
Only an executable policy decision may carry an OptimizationSpec.
Confidence describes interpretation quality, not surgery safety or measured optimization evidence.
Unsupported, refused, failed, and inconclusive evidence remains retained and inspectable.
The compiler is side-effect free and has no tensor-selection, mutation, or optimizer-strategy authority.
Unknown schema versions and contract drift fail closed.

compatibility.canonicalization: sorted compact UTF-8 JSON with deterministic diagnostic ordering
compatibility.additive_change_policy: Additive record fields require an explicitly compatible reader and regression coverage.
compatibility.breaking_change_policy: A changed field meaning, outcome, identity rule, or boundary requires a new schema version and migration test.
compatibility.provenance_policy: Original request, source links, provider/tool provenance, diagnostics, and negative outcomes remain part of the replay record.

implemented: Deterministic compiler to the existing ObjectiveContract
Fail-closed ambiguity and confidence policy evaluation
Versioned equivalence/refusal corpus and retained negative results
Direct CLI/Python optimization without a conversational provider
planned: Conversational campaign state, tool execution, and evidence-grounded explanations
current_availability.availability_rule: Implemented boundary artifacts do not imply that the full conversational product is available.

replay_protocol.focused_command: uv run pytest tests/test_v21_intent_contract.py tests/test_intent_compiler.py tests/test_intent_policy.py tests/test_intent_corpus.py
replay_protocol.environment: Python 3.12 with the project-managed uv.lock environment
known_skips: No provider-backed compiler implementation is registered; the corpus runs the built-in compiler and its public entrypoint aliases.
Full-model, GPU, llama.cpp, and long-running evidence workflows are outside the bounded v2.1 contract gate.
replay_protocol.retention_rule: Unavailable implementations and failed or inconclusive cases are recorded as known skips or retained negative evidence; they are never converted to a passing compiler result.
